description: Alternate worlds, time travel and increasingly self-aware adventures sit beside major confrontations with Ares and Hera, pushing the series beyond its earlier village-by-village structure.

s04e01.description: Hercules and Autolycus team up to rescue the caretaker of golden Harpy eggs from the clutches of a giant living in the clouds.

s04e02.description: When Iolaus is unable to save a woman from falling to her death, Fortune, goddess of luck, attempts to relieve his anguish by taking away his memory of everything, including Hercules.

s04e03.description: Hercules reminisces about the accidental death of a childhood bully, when Celesta arrives to take the brother of the deceased boy to the Elysian Fields.

s04e04.description: Hercules and Iolaus team up with a woman pirate to battle a queen who is now part arachnid.

s04e05.description: Following a fierce battle with Ares, Hercules races to rescue Iolaus from a cutthroat parallel universe and save the life of his father, Zeus.

s04e06.description: After finding out he's a father, Hercules engages in a fierce battle with Ares over the life of the magically endowed baby.

s04e07.description: Hercules fights members of a renegade Amazon clan to reunite a blind teenager with his sister, who is a member of the female warriors' group.

s04e08.description: In order to help a village girl, Hercules agrees to be her partner in a dance contest. They attend the dance classes of a very extravagant teacher.

s04e09.description: The blacksmith Atalanta forges a perfect likeness of Hercules, which raises havoc when it comes to life.

s04e10.description: Hercules is tried for manslaughter when a man impersonating him is killed while doing a good deed.

s04e11.description: Hercules and Iolaus reminisce about their first battle with the fire-breathing Ghidra, the seductive powers of Medea and Hera's meddling tactics.

s04e12.description: On the run from phony murder charges, Autolycus and Salmoneus change their names to Autolyca and Salmonella and join Widow Twanky's all-female dance troupe.

s04e13.description: Hope frees Callisto and sends her back in time to keep Hercules from being born.

s04e14.description: Hercules struggles to escape the Netherworld while Iolaus races through an altered timeline to stop Callisto from killing Alcmene and erasing Hercules from history.

s04e15.description: The writers and producers of "Hercules" panic when the star of the show is nowhere to be found following an earthquake in modern day Los Angeles.

s04e16.description: Discord purchases Artemis' purloined bow and, with an arrow, turns Hercules into a pig.

s04e17.description: Ares punishes Iolaus and Autolycus for turning Discord into a chicken by chaining them together. Hercules' pig friend fulfills her dream of becoming human.

s04e18.description: Autolycus uses the voluptuous and naive Cupcake to distract Prince Alexandros so he can steal the ruler's famous sapphire as Antioch and Carpathia ready for war.

s04e19.description: A bitter King Iphicles' actions against Grecian war veterans puts his and Iolaus's lives in danger when they have to battle the carnivorous sandworms.

s04e20.description: Hercules reminisces about his first battle against the Parthans as he comforts his dying mother, Alcmene, and confronts his father, Zeus.

s04e21.description: Zeus' proposal for Hercules to join him as a god on Mount Olympus brings up memories of the warrior's first brush with divine immortality.

s04e22.description: Hera blackmails Zeus into becoming mortal. Hercules battles the gods to return Alcmene's soul to the Elysian Fields and restore his father's powers.
